title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the final relationship C_p - C_v = 3alpha Mp/rho.

title: First Law Application
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the first law of thermodynamics to relate dQ, dU, and dV.

title: Coefficient of Linear Expansion
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly define the coefficient of linear expansion and relate it to volume change.

title: Substitution Steps
description: Important Criteria: The student should show appropriate substitution of dV/dT into the equation for C_p - C_v.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign mistakes or incorrect factors in the final equation.

title: Thermodynamic Relationships
description: Optional Criteria: The student may discuss the relationship between heat capacities and thermodynamic properties.
